hook.text: Ever touched a door handle and got ZAPPED? Here's why.

rub.text: When Dash shuffles across the carpet, his rubber soles rub the fibers and steal tiny particles called electrons.

spread.text: Rubber won't let them escape, so they spread all over him. Even his hair stands up: the extra electrons push each other away.

volts.text: By the door, he's carrying about ten thousand volts.

tip.text: Metal is an easy road for electrons, so they rush into his fingertip,

jump.text: and jump the last few millimeters all at once. A tiny bolt of lightning!

zap.text: Lots of volts, but far too little current to hurt. Just a sting.

key.text: Newt's trick? Touch the metal with a key first. The spark hits the key, not your skin.
